nodes.line: You're standing on my grass. Everyone is always standing on my grass.

options.label: Ask about the pigeons
options.response: The pigeons? Ha. You noticed. Most people don't notice. Count them sometime. All of them.

options.label: Ask if he needs help around the park
options.response: Help? Nobody helps. They hire contractors now. Contractors with lanyards.

options.label: Step off the grass
options.response: That's what I thought.

nodes.line: Forty years I kept this park. The birds know me. The new ones don't.

options.label: What new ones?
options.response: The ones that don't eat. The ones that watch. You didn't hear it from me.

options.label: Report your count
options.response: Hm. That's three more than last week. The Forms will want to know. Good work.

options.label: Back away slowly
options.response: Feed them nothing. They have their own budget.

nodes.line: Window is closed. Window has always been closed. Take a number.

options.label: Ask about Form 27-B
options.response: Form 27-B is not distributed. It is collected. That is the entire procedure.

options.label: Take a number
options.response: Your number is 9,412. Now serving: 3.

options.label: Leave the Bureau
options.response: Your visit has been logged. Have a compliant day.

nodes.line: Everyone asks about 27-B eventually. The Forms know. The Forms always know.

options.label: Ask where to find one
options.response: Find one? Citizen, one does not find a 27-B. One is chosen by it.

options.label: Pretend you never asked
options.response: Asked what? Exactly. You learn quickly.

nodes.line: Walk and talk. Don't look at me. Look at the pigeons. Everyone looks at the pigeons.

options.label: Ask about work with Flock
options.response: Flock pays wages to put cameras up. Steady money. Steady everything. Interested?

options.label: Mention the Form 27-B you are definitely not filling in
options.response: You didn't get that from me. The Forms move through people like me. Consider it moved.

options.label: Report in after orientation
options.response: Word travels. You're on the ladder roster now. Try not to fall off anything official.

options.label: Ask who takes cameras down
options.response: People who like scrap more than wages. People with cutters. People like you, maybe.

options.label: Keep walking
options.response: We never spoke. We never speak. Remember that.

nodes.line: Orientation is simple. You hold the ladder. You ask no questions. The pay clears weekly.

options.label: Ask about the pay
options.response: Enough. Wages for the ladder, scrap for the brave. Both sides of the blanket, friend.

options.label: Decline, for now
options.response: The offer stands. The offer always stands. That should worry you.

nodes.line: Ain't America grand? Ain't it grand to be free? Ain't it grand to be free in America?

options.label: Ask about America
options.response: America is grand. America is free. America is free and grand. I bought my house for $40k. You kids just don't know hard work. You kids just don't know hard work and freedom.

options.label: Leave Boomer alone
options.response: You kids just don't know hard work and freedom. You kids just don't know hard work and freedom and America.

name: THE GREAT AND POWERFUL CYBERHORSE
role: Equine of Mystery, By the Duck Pond

nodes.line: BEHOLD. I am the CYBERHORSE. Machine and steed. Terror of the grid. You may approach.

options.label: Ask how you may serve
options.response: The GEESE have stolen my INFINITE CARBURETOR. Retrieve it and know glory.

options.label: Squint at the sunglasses
options.response: These are TACTICAL OPTICS. Military grade. Do not touch the tactical optics.

options.label: Back away from the horse
options.response: WISE. Few can withstand my glow. Return when you are braver.

nodes.line: The carburetor hums at a frequency only I can hear. Also I cannot hear it. It is that advanced.

options.label: Present a bent paperclip
options.response: YES. The INFINITE CARBURETOR. You have the eye. But a greater trial awaits.

options.label: Admit you found nothing
options.response: The geese are crafty. Do not return carburetor-less. It embarrasses us both.

nodes.line: Next: the PIGEONS have hacked my HOOF-MODEM. You must reset it by counting them. Loudly.

options.label: Report a confident number
options.response: A fine number. The modem hums anew. One trial remains, champion.

options.label: Ask what a hoof-modem is
options.response: It is a modem. In my hoof. Do not overthink the sacred machinery.

nodes.line: The final trial: the DUCK POND reflects my glory. Fetch me a pebble from its center. A wet one.

options.label: Hand over a dripping pebble
options.response: The pebble is adequate. You may now gaze upon the truth of me. GAZE.

options.label: Point out you cannot swim
options.response: Then the pond shall keep its pebble. And you shall keep your shame.

nodes.line: BEHOLD. I remove the tactical optics.

options.label: Look closely
options.response: ...I am a horse. A regular horse. The sunglasses were a gift shop purchase. Tell no one. The geese respect branding.
